mechanics.description: Royalty + Income Tax model. Contractor holds equity. Government take = royalty + CIT + SPT (where applicable).
Production Sharing Contract. Cost recovery first, then profit oil split. Take = royalty + FTP + govt profit oil + CIT on contractor share.
Technical Service Contract. IOC earns fixed remuneration fee per barrel. All production sold by NOC. Take = (Revenue - Fee) / Revenue.
Risk Service Contract. Similar to TSC but IOC bears exploration risk. Remuneration is a function of capital employed + profit margin.
Profit-Related Resource Rent Tax. Applied on cash flow after uplift allowances. Australia-specific. Very progressive.
Indonesia-specific post-2017 PSC reform. No cost recovery. Gross split of production: base + sliding scales for price, depth, production stage.
Iran-specific. IOC funds capex, recovers via oil sales at ceiling price. No equity. Low upside.

fact_keys.description: TSC remuneration fee per barrel produced

take_formula.description: Government take = (total government revenues) / gross production revenue
components: Govt profit oil × profit oil pool
take_formula.note: For PSC: profit oil pool = (gross revenue - royalty - FTP - cost recovery). For TSC: government take = 1 - (remuneration fee / gross revenue per barrel).
